request: Investigate the hold-up on order ORD-1008.

steps.text: I will look up the order details first to see its fulfillment status, warehouse, line items, and promised delivery date.
I will check inventory for each ordered SKU at WH-DAL to see if the warehouse can fulfill the quantities.
I will check inventory for SKU-606 at WH-DAL to confirm whether there is enough stock for that line item.
I will search other warehouses for SKU-303 to see if a single location can cover the shortfall of 10 units for a transfer recommendation.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1008 is on hold due to a shortage of SKU-303 at the assigned warehouse WH-DAL; other line items have sufficient stock. A single alternative warehouse (WH-BOS) can cover the 10-unit shortfall for transfer.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1008 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-DAL (Dallas Distribution Center), promised_delivery_date 2026-03-17, is_past_promised_date false.
check_inventory: SKU-303 at WH-DAL available 20 (ordered 30), on_hand 22, reserved 2.
check_inventory: SKU-606 at WH-DAL available 250 (ordered 100), on_hand 250, reserved 0.
find_alternative_stock: SKU-303 required_quantity 10 excluding WH-DAL — WH-BOS available 50 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 6 false; WH-CHI available 5 false.
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient stock of SKU-303 at WH-DAL (available 20 vs ordered 30) preventing fulfillment.
uncertainties: Whether an inter-warehouse transfer can arrive at WH-DAL in time to meet the 2026-03-17 promised date without expediting.
arguments.recommendation: Arrange an inter-warehouse transfer today of 10 units of SKU-303 from WH-BOS to WH-DAL and expedite the move so the order can be picked and shipped to meet the 2026-03-17 promise.
